locations.note: After the Tojo chairman is gunned down, Kiryu holds Kamurocho, the series' Kabukicho, against Ryuji Goda's invasion and fights him atop the Kamurocho Hills construction site.
Kiryu comes to Sotenbori, the series' Dotonbori, to make peace with the Omi Alliance, makes a rival of Ryuji Goda and teams up with Osaka detective Kaoru Sayama.
In the original release Kiryu's Osaka chapters also take him into Shinseicho, the game's Shinsekai, the old quarter under Tsutenkaku Tower.

routes.name: Kiryu between Tokyo and Osaka
routes.note: From Terada's ambush in Kamurocho to the Omi in Sotenbori and back, twice, to the last fight with Ryuji on Kamurocho Hills.
